opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme; hold a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process; match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process; match funding required.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public for most of the year and listed (Grade I/II* or Scheduled Monument in England/Wales; Category A/B or Scheduled Monument in Scotland; Grade A/B+ or Scheduled Monument in NI). UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with clear public access and engagement. Two-stage application process; match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme; hold a permanent collection of national significance and open to the public for most of the year. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces. Two-stage application process; match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, where performing arts constitute the vast majority of activities. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally purchasing related specialist equipment. Two-stage application process; match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process; match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting pupils at secondary level. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills for employment or independent living after school or college. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially helping young people transition from children's to adults' services. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing care to patients and their families. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Projects require capital costs of at least £50,000 and a shortfall of at least £25,000. Two-stage application process.
